title: Titanium Engine Pylon Bracket
alloyReason: Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V (UNS R56320) is specified for Titanium Engine Pylon Bracket where intermediate strength between CP titanium and Ti-6Al-4V is needed with superior cold formability. Its 620 MPa tensile strength with 20% elongation enables 30% weight reduction versus steel while allowing tube bending and flaring without intermediate annealing — critical for Engine mounting pylon bracket/lug requiring complex-formed geometries. This rationale is driven by engine mounting pylon bracket/lug and service environment demands.
process: 5-axis CNC roughing for engine component geometry
Wire EDM contour profiling at 200W fiber laser
CMM per AS9102 at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Shot peening Almen 0.008-0.012A inducing compressive residual stress for extended HCF life in aerospace service — tailored for engine mounting pylon application
inspection: Eddy current surface scan (engine mounting verified)
commonFailures: SCC in chloride-rich marine atmosphere - controlled by bake-out 300C + corrosion-inhibiting primer — critical for engine mounting pylon performance

faq.q: What material traceability standards does Titanium Engine Pylon Bracket comply with?
faq.a: Titanium Engine Pylon Bracket provides full material traceability per AS9100 Rev D with EN 10204 Type 3.1 documentation. Each component is marked with heat code, batch number, and serial number. First Article Inspection (FAI) per AS9102 is available with dimensional, material, and process verification — mandatory for engine mounting pylon in flight-critical assemblies.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Engine Pylon Bracket orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Engine Pylon Bracket is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Engine Pylon Bracket?
faq.a: Each Titanium Engine Pylon Bracket shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for engine mounting pylon.
